issues.legal_issue: Comparable acquisition evidence, rising prices, road access, and development potential justify enhancing the assessed market value, subject to a deduction for development costs.
material_facts: The claimants’ land was near a main road and had access to roads laid between the date of an earlier comparable acquisition and the later acquisition.
An earlier award for nearby land acquired for road widening assessed its value at six rupees per square yard.
The courts below had found that land prices were steadily rising, but had rejected further enhancement because the land lay inside the main road.
The land was found to have potential for housing development, and the Court applied a one-third deduction for development charges.
issues.conclusion: The Court enhanced the gross market value to eight rupees per square yard and applied a one-third deduction for development charges, holding the claimants entitled to the resulting amount.
issues.legal_principle: Market value may be assessed by reference to a comparable earlier acquisition, adjusted for the rise in prices and the acquired land’s access and development potential. Where development is needed, a deduction may be made for development charges. The Court relied on the earlier award, Exhibit P-7, but cited no statutory provision or earlier judicial decision for this valuation method.

rule.if: compensation_valuation_appeal and comparable_nearby_acquisition and rising_land_prices and (road_access or development_potential)

predicates.compensation_valuation_appeal: The case is an appeal concerning the valuation of land acquired for compensation.
predicates.comparable_nearby_acquisition: An earlier acquisition of nearby land provides a comparable valuation reference.
predicates.rising_land_prices: The evidence or findings show that land prices rose over the relevant period.
predicates.road_access: The acquired land had access to roads or comparable transport facilities.
predicates.development_potential: The acquired land had potential for development that could affect its market value.

issues.definition: When a compensation valuation appeal involves a comparable nearby acquisition, rising prices, and road access or development potential, the market value is enhanced with an appropriate deduction for development.

issues.legal_issue: A claim concerning land situated far from the land in the appeal may be dismissed when it stands on the same footing as claims previously rejected in comparable proceedings.
material_facts: The appeal also concerned a separate parcel situated far from the other land at issue.
The Court had previously refused leave and dismissed special leave petitions concerning land it regarded as standing on the same footing.
issues.conclusion: The appeal concerning the separate, distant parcel was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: The Court treated the separate parcel as standing on the same footing as land in earlier special leave proceedings that had been dismissed. It relied on its order dismissing those petitions; no statutory provision or named earlier judgment was cited for this disposition.

predicates.special_leave_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal by special leave concerning a land claim.
predicates.land_is_remote_from_other_disputed_land: The land concerned is situated far from the other land involved in the appeal.
predicates.analogous_prior_claims_were_dismissed: The Court previously dismissed comparable claims involving land regarded as standing on the same footing.

issues.definition: In a special leave appeal, a claim concerning remote land is dismissed when comparable prior claims involving land on the same footing were dismissed.

issues.legal_issue: Equitable solatium may be awarded despite legal ineligibility when delay in appointing an arbitrator after rejection of the compensation offer warrants relief.
material_facts: The claimants rejected the compensation offer, after which the arbitrator was appointed five years later.
The claimants sought solatium in equity, relying on decisions that had granted solatium where appointment of an arbitrator was substantially delayed.
The Court held that the claimants were entitled to solatium at fifteen per cent of the market value.
issues.conclusion: The Court awarded solatium at fifteen per cent of the market value on equitable grounds.
issues.legal_principle: Although the claimants were not legally entitled to solatium, the Court granted it in equity in view of the delay in appointing the arbitrator. It relied on Union of India v. Hari Krishan Khosla and Harbans Singh Shanni Devi v. Union of India, in which solatium had been granted in light of delays in appointing arbitrators. The Court distinguished the circumstances here and awarded a lower rate than the rate mentioned in the earlier equitable award.

rule.if: compensation_arbitration_proceeding and compensation_offer_rejected and arbitrator_appointment_delayed and claimants_lack_legal_entitlement_to_solatium

predicates.compensation_arbitration_proceeding: The proceeding concerns compensation determined through arbitration.
predicates.compensation_offer_rejected: The claimants rejected the compensation offer before the arbitrator was appointed.
predicates.arbitrator_appointment_delayed: The appointment of the arbitrator was delayed after the offer was rejected.
predicates.claimants_lack_legal_entitlement_to_sola: The claimants are not legally entitled to solatium but seek it on equitable grounds.

issues.definition: When claimants in a compensation arbitration proceeding reject an offer, the arbitrator’s appointment is delayed, and the claimants lack legal entitlement to solatium, the Court may award solatium in equity.

issues.legal_issue: An unchallenged rate of interest awarded on compensation remains payable.
material_facts: The arbitrator had awarded interest at six per cent per annum.
The claimants did not challenge the rate of interest in their appeal.
issues.conclusion: The Court held that the claimants were entitled to interest at the rate already awarded.
issues.legal_principle: The Court noted that the claimants had not challenged the rate of interest and accordingly affirmed their entitlement to interest at that rate. No statutory provision or earlier case was cited on this point.

predicates.compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning compensation.
predicates.interest_was_awarded: The decision under appeal awarded interest on the compensation.
predicates.claimants_did_not_challenge_interest_rat: The claimants did not contest the rate of interest in the appeal.

issues.definition: In a compensation appeal, interest already awarded remains payable when the claimants did not challenge its rate.
